utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll share the repair drive date and time, and that you’re looking for tools, volunteers, and broken items to fix.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks, Jules. Send me the date and time, and I’ll help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll send the date and time along with the call for tools, volunteers, and broken items to fix. Thanks, Noah!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 still works for me—I’ll keep it after pickup and coordinate the drop-off quietly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — I’ll keep asking a few more neighbors so we have a buffer for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll stay flexible on the school side and keep it discreet.

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll be there at 10 with my tools and a few extras. I’ll also bring gloves and can point anyone else to the parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great—thanks, Gus. I’ll point folks to the community center parking lot at 10, and the repair drive is still at the shed by Maple and 3rd from 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — if we can get the drop-off spot and the list, I can sort out my part. I just want to keep everything tidy after pickup so we don’t create a mess.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I can bring the tape, nails, and a flashlight, and I’ll ask a couple more neighbors just in case. I’ll head over soon with what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds great, thanks. Just let me know where to drop everything off so I can plan around pickup and keep things from getting crowded.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — send me the details, and I’ll get the word out to everyone I can for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep repeating the repair drive details and remind folks to bring anything broken that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll keep spreading the word, too, and make sure everyone knows to bring their broken items to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s great, Tess—thank you. I’ll bring my tool bag later and help wherever I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful, Oren—your tool bag will come in handy. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. I’ll stop by later and see what else they still need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m out running errands anyway, so I’ll check whether they still need drop-offs and pass along the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. Please let them know we’re still looking for tools, volunteers, and any broken items folks want fixed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll ask about tools, volunteers, and broken items, then I’ll pass along whatever they still need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Mara — I’ll be there at 10:00 by the community center parking lot with gloves and my basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — 10:00 at the community center parking lot works, and thanks for bringing the gloves and tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Mara — I’ll keep it simple and be there at 10:00 with gloves and my basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the latest repair drive details one more time? I want to make sure I’ve got the time and place right before I pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure—just tell them to meet at the community shed this Saturday afternoon, and we still need tools, a few screws, and help with lifting.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — just to confirm, what time Saturday afternoon and are there any other drop-off items I should mention?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, we’re still on for the repair drive this afternoon, right? What time should I swing by?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, we’re still on — swing by this afternoon and I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — I’ll swing by this afternoon and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — I can bring a few things by, but I’d like to keep it quiet on my end.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Totally fine — I’ll keep it quiet and just handle the last stretch when I get there. Send me whatever’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll send you a quiet list of what’s still needed and coordinate a low-key drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’m organizing the repair drive now, and I’d love your help with the list or timing if you’re up for it. What part would you like to take on?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can help by checking what they still need and where the drop-off should be. I’ll also ask around for a couple extension cords and see if anyone can cover the morning shift.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s fantastic, Nell — thank you. Please check the needs and drop-off spot, and I’ll note you down for the extension cords and morning shift coverage.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — the repair drive is at the community center parking lot this Saturday from 10:00 to 2:00, and please bring work gloves plus any basic tools you have.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word that it’s this Saturday from 10:00 to 2:00 at the community center parking lot, and that you’re looking for volunteers, tools, and any broken items people want fixed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — that’s perfect. If anyone asks, just point them to the community center parking lot at 10:00 this Saturday with gloves, tools, and broken items.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive — I might’ve missed the latest update. What’s left for me to do?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: We still need the list checked off and the timing locked in — if you can help organize the supplies, that’d be a big help. I’ll bring the screwdrivers, duct tape, and a couple flashlights and catch the last stretch.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I can help organize the supplies and check off the list. Just point me to whatever still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check while I’m out and let you know if they still need any drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Ira — that helps. Once you know, could you let me know the drop-off spot too?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll ask about the drop-off spot and send you both the location and any updates once I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep coordinating and let you know if I need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and help gather anyone who can pitch in. Just send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll send the details soon, and I really appreciate you helping gather people for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Gus—I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if they need extra hands or a few more odds and ends.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess—I really appreciate that. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up before this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet—I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything new before this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — just let me know what they still need, and I can swing by if needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Bo — I’ll check what they still need and pass it along. I’m still planning to repeat the repair drive reminder to a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — keep me posted, and I can swing by if they need anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — I can quietly bring a few things by, and I’ll text when I’m ready to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be wonderful, Uli — thanks. Just text me when you’re on the way, and I’ll meet you there if I can remember where I put my keys.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — I’ll text you before I head over, and no rush on the keys.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—send me the time window and repair list when it’s ready, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll send you the time window and repair list shortly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mina — I’ll watch for it and plan around the window.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t gotten the full list yet, but I can check around for more extension cords and see who’s free for the morning shift. If you hear any other shortages, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell — extension cords and morning help would be great. I’ll let you know if I hear of any other shortages.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll keep asking around and pass along anything I hear. If you find the drop-off spot or the full list, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the latest repair drive details one more time so I don’t mix anything up?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure — we’re meeting at 10:00 by the community center parking lot, and please bring work gloves plus any basic tools you have.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — just to confirm, it’s 10:00 at the community center parking lot, and I should bring work gloves plus basic tools, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — I’m heading over soon, so swing by in the next little bit and we’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll swing by in a bit, then. You want me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: If you can, bring a couple extra flashlights — that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m pulling the repair drive details together and could use a hand with the list and timing. What part would you like to help with?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help with the supplies list and timing, and I’ll bring my extra tape, nails, and a flashlight too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Cleo — thank you. I’ll send over the details, and we can use your help to keep the list and timing on track.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
